The focus is on building reliable AI applications while improving model performance, inference throughput, latency, and operating costs.

The role involves serving large language models using vLLM and SGLang, implementing reinforcement-learning pipelines with Megatron-LM and Prime Intellect frameworks, and optimizing GPU workloads for production environments. The engineer will collaborate with infrastructure specialists on GPU scheduling and fleet utilization and with product stakeholders on development priorities. * Develop and operate post-training workflows with Prime Intellect tooling, including prime-rl, the Environments Hub, and verifiers.
